firstContext: 🍖 FEAST 📺 — Marcus opens the pantry wide: 3× Foraged food, 1× Foraged food, 2× Burdock. Ivy eat until the fire burns low. 🍖 FEASTED ×2.53 until tomorrow's dawn (6 parts left): a proper feast. A channeled keepsake feeds the flames (devotion ×1.5). Arc IV burns hotter. Strikes and abilities hit with the feast behind them.

The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
You don't know what that was. The sky, clearing its throat. Someone at the haven should hear about this.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 🗣️ Sari to Gilberto, by the fire: "148 wood. We need 350. The forest isn't going to cut itself."
Riders on the ridge — no, a cart. A TRADER. Word travels: Haven has food, and where there's food there's trade.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
📺 SYSTEM: "TONIGHT: The Death Reel. Highlights. Yes, including yours. Especially yours."
📺 SYSTEM: "The Death Reel ran your highlights. Somewhere out there, your showbiz fans are making clips."

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (15/7/7), with 3 wave-4 and 1 wave-5 fought, 9 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 5 · Forage 15 · Craft 8 · Talk 15 · Explore 33 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Ivy Wang ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,071 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.
